stem: $X$ and $Y$ are independent random variables with distributions $\text{Po}(1.6)$ and $\text{Po}(2.3)$ respectively.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.stem: A random sample of 75 values of $X$ is taken.
parts.text: State the approximate distribution of the sample mean, $\bar{X}$, including the values of the parameters.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: Hence find the probability that the sample mean is more than 1.7.

parts.label: (iv)
parts.text: Explain whether the Central Limit theorem was needed to answer part **(ii)**.
